punchline: Two points of narrowing mean little until you see the other group moving the opposite way.
thirty_sec: In the Lifestyle Heart Trial, 48 coronary patients were split into a lifestyle programme group of 28 and a usual-care group of 20. After a year the average artery narrowing fell from 40.0 to 37.8 percent in the programme group and rose from 42.7 to 46.1 percent in the controls; the effect is small and the programme was a bundle of changes.
question: Which improvement have you credited to a change without asking what a comparison group would show?
key_contrast: A result is read against the comparison group, not alone.
